remarks: OEM heat release is required; interface to power island
text: Turbine halls (gas turbine hall and steam turbine hall) shall be ventilated by roof ventilators (4 x 25 % groups per hall per the equipment records) with low-level louvred inlet openings fitted with salt drift eliminators and coarse filters; the airflow shall limit the hall temperature to ambient + 10 K at 40 degC with the heat release from the OEM (radiation and leakage of casings, generators, lube oil systems) and shall give at least 6 air changes per hour at the base ventilation, with the failure of one 25 % group not causing the design temperature to be exceeded by more than 3 K.
